## Content

See the full, auto-generated content index with per-page links and
descriptions at [llms-full.txt](https://hawebstudio.com/llms-full.txt),
regenerated from `content/` on every build via `pnpm seo:llms`.

## Usage Guidance

Use canonical URLs from the sitemap. Prefer page titles, descriptions,
headings, and JSON-LD entities as the source of truth when summarizing
HA Web Studio content.
